_comment: Baseline per-flow duration in seconds, feeding the LPT bin-packing in scripts/resolve-maestro-shard.mjs. Recorded from CI run 32373171812 (mobile-e2e-android, 2026-08-20, all four shards, no stall present) via `gh api repos/muratkeremozcan/couture-cast/actions/jobs/<id>/logs | grep -oE "\[(Passed|Failed)\] .+ \([0-9hms ]+\)"`. A flow with no entry here falls back to the mean of the recorded values; refresh this file when a flow's shape changes enough to move its cost meaningfully, not on every run's natural variance.
_comment_community_comments: community-comments.yaml's 150 is an estimate after the Story 6.7b R17 change, which reaches lookbook-5 through the notification deep link instead of the tab, filter and swipe walk: its CI run 40145652214 took 305 s, of which 120 s was a one-off Maestro clear-state stall and about 47 s the removed tab, filter and walk; local Android runs of the new flow took 136 to 160 s against 213 s for the old one. Replace it with the next green mobile-e2e-android figure, read with the grep in the first comment.
_comment_community_feed: community-feed.yaml's 152 is its first green mobile-e2e-android run after the Story 6.7b R15 split (CI run 40145652214, head 19370db5, 2026-10-24), read with the grep in the first comment. Before the split, which moved the reactions and their relaunch leg to community-reactions.yaml, it cost 291s in CI run 40129129204.
_comment_community_reactions: community-reactions.yaml's 109 is its first green mobile-e2e-android run (CI run 40145652214, head 19370db5, 2026-10-24), read with the grep in the first comment. The flow is new in Story 6.7b R15.
_comment_community_sponsored_highlights: community-sponsored-highlights.yaml's 116 is the median of its four green mobile-e2e-android runs (CI runs 40123427091, 40129129204, the 8aba88af run and 40145652214, 2026-10-24: 132s, 128s, 103s, 92s), read with the grep in the first comment.
_comment_community_spotlight: community-spotlight.yaml's 50 is an ESTIMATE, not a recording: the flow is new in Story 6.6 and has never run in CI. It has two network waits, an optional View more and a detail round trip, so it is entered just under community-feed.yaml rather than at the ~78s mean. Replace it with the figure from the first green mobile-e2e-android run using the grep in the first comment.
_comment_home_spotlight_teaser: home-spotlight-teaser.yaml's 126 is a local measurement, not a CI recording: the flow is new in Story 6.7 and its first local Android run on emulator-5554 took 2m 6s, launch preamble included. Replace it with the figure from the first green mobile-e2e-android run using the grep in the first comment.
_comment_location_capture: location-capture.yaml's 103 is the median of its six green mobile-e2e-android runs in CI runs 39886209236 to 39896928527 (2026-10-22/23: 98s, 85s, 107s, 84s, 149s, 110s), read with the grep in the first comment. Local Android runs after the sentinel and double-guard changes took 85s to 86s.
